metadata.note: Candidate definitions are not part of the active semantic catalog. No value may be returned for these IDs until the owner reviews the definition, source field, units, currency, consolidation basis, and coverage, and the approved data is added to a versioned public payload.

glossary.resolution: The current published snapshot exposes RASK (income per ASK-km), not a monetary revenue total. Ask for clarification if the user means unit revenue; otherwise explain that total revenue is not available.
The current published snapshot exposes CASK (cost per ASK-km), not a monetary cost total. Do not multiply by ASK unless an approved payload explicitly defines the compatible source and basis.
Fuel price and fuel per ASK are not the same as total fuel expense. No approved total fuel expense field is present in the published snapshot.
Do not substitute unit margin, EBITDAR, or net income. No approved operating income total is present in the published snapshot.
Quarterly company reported counts can be summed only across complete quarter coverage. Distinguish this measure from AFAC passengers.
Use the selected AFAC segment and period. Do not treat this as equivalent to company reported passengers.
